title: The Grain Under Wool

arc.title: The Cold Stone

epigraph.text: The pot keeps its crack, the grain keeps its cost, and the yard goes around the place where the hand did not come back. Ask any of them what a thing is worth and it will tell you the weather.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of Low Kiln, in the last days of Ash

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and fifty-four to three hundred and fifty-six days, six months and one hundred and seventy-four to one hundred and seventy-six days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: as in chapters 25 through 100 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it, with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and fifty-four, fifty-five and fifty-six days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, never numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources. Eight arithmetics of the year stand behind one unsigned figure, eight are eight and not one account, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine out of eight; both of Ash's subtractions ride locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay's box. Six openings in six months are six and not a rule, the widow's mark last touched at the kiln mouth on Ash 2 and untouched since. The burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, nine record-first hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction stand apart with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid. Ash 30 (Day 359) stands three mornings ahead and is named only as a date.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Fifth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{354}{Ash 25, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 282 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking. No recap: nothing from Ash 22, 23 or 24 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the word that went over the boards on the twenty-third stood nowhere to be asked and bought no lesson under this roof; the eight arithmetics stand locked and unread up the clay road in Berr's box, eight are eight and not one account, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine out of eight (T015/T041/T047 held). Carry 282 honest answers on the sixth place, six hearings with the seventh place empty, nine hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them and the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the row at five askings, and the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, still gathering and unspent (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). Count 353 → 354 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-three → one hundred and seventy-four days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 354 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust stiff and leathery two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face is not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside, slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire. The surgeon/infant quarrel — crust lifted two inches, thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle — both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar: Sella to the fire before the basket, coals told it is the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it* where another woman says I, small intake and hold and letting-go counted toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, lips moving along a two-gapped row and figuring neither gap, one glance at the clay jar standing cold under lead glaze with the hand shutting half over nothing, twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch, fingers in and out without closing and no handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077, T060/T086). The widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079). In the small hours the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold — answer 283: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the held objects (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Seven Places Again
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 25 through the going of the light and the bed, then the small hours. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Ilva this day, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no runner, no collector, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no market, Cross or bell, and no ownerless voice over the boards. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire to be banked against their coming back, never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw unswept both, the space under the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring with no scrape or crumb or print or chip or word, the trough's skin, the field's empty place on the worked strips, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — seven places entered none, for a thing entered wants a payer standing and none stood (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085). Dressed grain turned once under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child, no figure, fingers in and out without closing, the empty fingers kept on a place of its own beside the one object of Bone 22 as a keeping and not a second handful (T077). Hunts and repairs as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: the hare sent to the weather which carried the snow and can carry the price, the cracked jar sent to a pot that says nothing, the kindling woman asking what the seventh year will want, two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late; Tarn says *Yes, house* to each and keeps the late because it puts off the paying (T077, T036/T076). Tarn at the kindling keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, checks the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath and finds each where it was put and not made again — not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not a tenth stopping, not the calling of the loan, no payer standing — brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, loan uncalled; stroke over the flagstones without the half-check; four held changes on four places and not a rule; the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076/T006, T061/T082). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel; men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, no name given and the room not said to be cold; speaks to the wheel before any person — *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* — tells a pot *You'll do*, withholds the note known three turns ahead; bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites, holding and taking, no Grathic word for both mercies; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the claim gathers interest (T062/T035/T031). Whole file turned out as instruments on the towel and left as it lay; the far-off hand that will lay the private keepings together is still far off and not his. Going of the light: carried up at the half-pace, set on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted, half-beat at setting, thread left frozen, hearth grammar at the going of the light, widow's mark untouched. Small hours: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down, laid back on answer 284 (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Twenty-Sixth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{355}{Ash 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner or collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap. Carry 284 honest answers on the sixth place; eight arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box, figure read not figure paid, no signature, finding on its own place, no doctrine; six hearings with seventh place empty; nine hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside and the hand-at-sill breath beside that, none a sixth or seventh; burned slate at five with shut-room tellings at two and the row at five askings; well-saying at four shapings and Hessa's writing turned toward herself and unread; Ilva's strip unread; the Ash 23 direction standing on its own place beside the Ash 5 joining and Ash 17 direction with a finger between every pair, still gathering and unspent, with no sixth telling, no third shut-room telling, no witness and no payer (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). Count 354 → 355 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-four → one hundred and seventy-five days told by nobody (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid 355 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken 355 days (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order and the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed with neither verdict: leathery crust two inches off with corner a hair off the wool and empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside (T060/T086). Hearth grammar at both ends of the morning's opening, beat for beat: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, *The house will keep it*, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath the finger, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due. Weather texture of the dark month's last tend entered nowhere: a harder cold at the finger's-width door, the trough skin thick enough to hold a poured spoon, the river's note lower under the door, the carried fire at four and a gap under the floor, the kiln cold behind the wall (T083/T085, T088). Small hours: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down, laid back — answer 285, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Finger in the Iron
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry and THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 26 through the going of the light and the bed, then the small hours, at the Clay Yard's seven places and rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the boards, the wheel-shed edge and the damper, then the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail, Ilva (one appearance at the yard well); Garl in objects. Walk-ons about the ordinary yard work; no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no collector, no market, Cross or bell, and no ownerless voice — the directions of Ash 5, 17 and 23 stand where they were put and do not repeat. The yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number; three coverings stay weather with a finger between every pair; dressed grain covered and unfigured with no handful; hunts and repairs stay directions answered with the weather, the pot and the carrying arm (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085, T077, T098). Ilva at the well: pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam; her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays, the short notched birch strip pale where a thumb has rubbed it, not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away; eyes to the asker and mouth after both with a half-beat; to a woman asking what Ash's firings had taken she answers the question put and not the one behind it — *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* — and puts her flat hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and files it as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth and no tenth; he makes no reader of her own keeping, joins her to none, and she is expressly not the speaker of any voice (T080 advanced, not paid). **THE ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T062/T035/T031 and T061/T082):** at the damper, after the tongue has been moved and Sella's instruction has arrived at the pot and the household has straightened around the waiting, Jorra's bent finger stays in the cold iron a breath longer than the work required, taking the cold out of the fingertip and keeping it there; he does not make a song of it, does not name it and does not look toward the basket. The boy files the extra interval on a place of its own with a finger between it and the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and his own gaps: a keeping gathered once and not spent, expressly **not** a sixth held object, **not** a seventh, **not** an eighth of anything, **not** a habit, **not** a way, **not** a hearing, **not** a near-full answer, **not** a mending, **not** a cause, **not** a payment and **not** a rule, with no payer standing under it. It gathers toward the far-off hand that will lay the district's private keepings together, and that hand is not his. *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn; the claim goes on gathering interest against it (T062). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, checks the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath and finds each where put and not made again, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Whole file turned out on the towel and checked and left; no voice came over the boards to make a sixth telling, a third shut-room telling, a sixth asking, a fifth shaping, a tenth hand or a tenth stopping, and none was supplied to make a row come out even (T015/T041/T047, T078, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). Going of the light: carried up at the half-pace, set on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted, thread left frozen, hearth grammar at the going of the light, widow's mark untouched. Small hours: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down, laid back on answer 286, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Twenty-Seventh Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{356}{Ash 27, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner or collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap. Open with the hand laid down against the fold on answer 286. Carry 286 honest answers on the sixth place; eight arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box; six hearings with seventh place empty; nine hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and loan uncalled; five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside and the hand-at-sill breath beside that; burned slate at five, shut-room tellings at two, row at five askings, well-saying at four shapings; the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart; and the new holding of Ash 26 kept on a place of its own with a finger between it and every other object, gathered and not spent (T062/T035/T031, T061/T082). Count 355 → 356 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-five → one hundred and seventy-six days told by nobody (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid 356 days with payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken 356 days (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order and the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed with neither verdict: leathery crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside (T060/T086). Hearth grammar at both ends of the morning's opening, beat for beat: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath the finger, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due. Weather texture entered nowhere: the trough skin holding a poured spoon, the plate of ice lifted a little out of the path of feet, the river's note lower under the finger's-width door, carried fire at four and a gap (T083/T085, T088). Ash 30 (Day 359) stands three mornings ahead and is named only as a date, never as a promise, and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; no ninth arithmetic is supplied early. Small hours: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down, laid back — answer 287, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Wool Kept
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 27 at the Clay Yard's seven places, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the going of the light, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no collector, no market, Cross or bell, and no ownerless voice on the twenty-seventh — the directions of the fifth, seventeenth and twenty-third stand where they were put and do not repeat. The yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number; three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful lifted; hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085, T077, T098). Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, says *Yes, house* to early and late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, checks the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath and finds each where put and not made again — not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not a tenth stopping, not the calling of the loan, no payer standing — brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check; four held changes on four places and not a rule (T036/T076/T006, T061/T082). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note known three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking — and does **not** make again the extra holding of the twenty-sixth; finding it where it was put and leaving it there, so that a second would be a habit and a third a way, both of which want a payer and none stood. *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the claim gathers interest (T062/T035/T031). The whole file turned out as instruments on the towel and checked and left: six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty (the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go); heard bell four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; told figure beside the paid with no signature; **eight arithmetics of the year — three of Frost, first, second and third of Bone, Ash's first and second — behind one unsigned figure, eight are eight and not one account**, both Ash subtractions locked and unread up the clay road in Berr's box, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine standing up out of eight; nine record-first hands with no tenth (Ilva's ninth, Hessa's eighth); nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; row at five askings, burned slate at five, shut-room tellings at two, well-saying at four shapings, and the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid; and the new holding of Ash 26 on a place of its own beside the five objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the boy's gaps, with a finger between every pair, gathered and not spent, not a sixth, seventh or eighth held object, not a habit, not a rule, no payer standing. The far-off hand that will one day lay the district's private keepings together is still far off and is not his (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T078, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held; T062/T035/T031 advanced, not paid). Going of the light: Sella carries him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted without a look at his face, hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed, thread left frozen; tells the coals it is the thaw and *The house will keep it*, leaves the charcoal unread beneath her finger, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand. The widow's mark hangs where it hangs and is not touched — a going of the light and a bed are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079/T100). Small hours at the very end of the day: hand up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door the way a hand goes up in a field it has learned not to disturb; it does not reach and the inch is not a reach; it takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go is neither early again nor stayed and the hand does not stay; it is the note's own finishing that ends the interval, and that is the whole of the honesty in it. **Answer 288**: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the eight arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the new holding in the iron, the held breath at the sill, the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the pot-crack resting, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the Ash 23 direction, the word that stood in no doorway, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, the strip in the sleeve nor his own kept gaps (T061/T082). **356 exact**, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody under the Vail roof; six months and one hundred and seventy-six days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken the same number. Nothing on the twenty-seventh has been opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended. Ash keeps its twenty-seventh day without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is set right or left wrong in so many words; the month carries both names the way a pot carries two handles and is none the worse. Ash 30 (Day 359) stands three mornings ahead and is named only as a date, never as a promise; no ninth arithmetic is supplied early, no seventh opening made due, no sixth hearing, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping invented to make a row come out even. Three counts in three places — fire four and a gap, boards four, four and a knot, river low over lower — do not become one, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands; the bell's gap stays in its square and is not folded into any of them. The keeping of the number is the only honest work there has been to do, bought nothing at two inches of air, not for sale, and goes on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax.
